advwp.config.title: Advancement Waypoints Settings
advwp.config.chat_scanner.desc: Automatically detects coordinates in chat messages and makes them clickable for navigation.
advwp.config.enable_navigation.desc: Globally enables or disables all navigation HUD elements.
advwp.config.open_manager.desc: Open main menu for creating, editing, and managing waypoints and tabs.
advwp.config.hud_mode.desc: Choose your preferred navigation style: Arrow, Compass, or Player Locator.
advwp.config.hud_position.desc: The position on your screen where Arrow and Compass indicators are placed.
advwp.config.hud_scale.desc: Scale size of the Arrow and Compass indicators.
advwp.config.hud_offset.desc: Distance in pixels from the screen edge or hotbar.
advwp.config.show_distance_on_locator.de: Displays the distance to your target in meters above the hotbar instead of your experience level.
advwp.config.show_item_on_locator.desc: Replaces the default dot on the locator with the item of your selected waypoint.
advwp.config.left_click_action.desc: Action performed when left-clicking an achievement. 'TP / Navigate' teleports if you have operator permissions, otherwise starts navigation.
advwp.config.allow_attach_to_any_node.de: §c(Not recommended)§r Allows attaching custom waypoints to any intermediate achievement in vanilla tabs. By default, waypoints automatically shift to the end of the branch to prevent visual tree glitches.
advwp.config.auto_disable_radius.desc: Radius in blocks from destination where navigation auto-disables after the set time (0 = disabled).
advwp.config.auto_disable_time.desc: Time in seconds required inside the radius before navigation auto-disables.
advwp.config.proximity_pulse.desc: Smooth opacity blinking when inside the destination radius.
advwp.config.pulse_speed.desc: Speed of the indicator blinking when inside the destination radius.
